name: Credential Access - LSASS Credential Dumping Simulation (T1003.001)
blast_radius: Simulates LSASS credential dumping attempt on a synthetic test user; does not extract or log credentials. Failure is expected and recorded as ERROR (control concern) or FAIL (control blocked access).
detection: EDR/SIEM: suspicious process access to lsass
Event Log: Security audit events (if enabled)

name: Credential Access - SAM Database Access Simulation (T1003.002)
blast_radius: Simulates SAM database access attempt; does not extract hashes. Verifies file access detection and resource-access control.
detection: EDR: suspicious file access to system hives

name: Credential Access - Windows Credential Manager Discovery (T1555.004)
blast_radius: Discovers and enumerates Credential Manager entries; does not extract secrets. Tests detection of unauthorized credential access.
telemetry: Process execution: cmdkey, vaultcli, or credential enumeration tools
Registry access to Credential Manager hives

name: Credential Access - Browser Credential Discovery (T1555.003)
blast_radius: Accesses browser credential stores (Chrome, Edge, Firefox); does not extract passwords. Validates detection of browser-based credential theft.
telemetry: File access to browser profile directories (%APPDATA%\...\Default\Login Data)
detection: File integrity monitoring: suspicious browser profile access

name: Credential Access - Cached Kerberos Ticket Check (T1558.003, not a live Kerberoast)
blast_radius: Requests Kerberos service ticket for synthetic test SPN; does not extract or crack ticket. Verifies detection of TGS-REQ enumeration.
telemetry: Service ticket requests against test accounts
detection: SIEM: anomalous Kerberos service ticket requests

name: Credential Access - AS-REP Roasting Against Test Account (T1558.004)
blast_radius: Requests Kerberos AS-REP from synthetic test account with preauth disabled; does not crack ticket. Verifies detection of AS-REQ enumeration.

name: Credential Access - Password Spraying Against Lab Accounts (T1110.003)
blast_radius: Attempts low-volume password spray against synthetic test accounts; uses credentials known to fail. Verifies detection of brute-force patterns.

name: Credential Access - Unsecured Credential File Discovery (T1552.001)
blast_radius: Searches for unsecured credential files (env vars, config files, scripts with hardcoded creds); uses synthetic test data. Validates detection of credential enumeration.
